summary: InferAll is an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible AI gateway. New accounts get 25 free NVIDIA NIM calls with no card. A one-time $5 activation (which becomes spendable balance, not a fee) then unlocks ongoing $0 input/output access to 10+ NIM open-source models — Nemotron, GLM 5.3, Gemma 4 and more — within free-plan daily caps of 50 chat / 100 text / 20 image-analyze / 10 image-generate / 5 video-generate requests per day.
claim_steps: Create an account and get an API key at inferall.ai/keys — no card for the first 25 NIM calls.
Call the OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible endpoint with any listed $0 NIM model id.
To keep ongoing free NIM access after the 25-call trial, pay the one-time $5 activation; it becomes spendable balance for premium providers.

social_proof.title: Pricing — InferAll AI Gateway
social_proof.text: The 10+ open-source models on NVIDIA NIM are $0 input and $0 output, capped only by the free-plan daily request rate (50 chat / 100 text / 20 image-analyze / 10 image-generate / 5 video-generate per day). New accounts get 25 free NIM calls before any payment; after those, the $5 starter pack unlocks ongoing NIM access.
